about: Test vectors for the three War Bay hire doors (src/sim/systems/hire.ts), the task, appeal, sanction, citation, chamber, co-founding and guild doors, presented through src/sim/systems/present.ts, recorded on the small layout: seed 42, size 96, population 100, layout small, mind declineFounding, the holder vectors-small:42 named governor at the founding, from tick 0. The 2,000-person world of vectors.json lays no Institute, so no credential can be earned there; here four holders admitted at tick 0 graduate together at tick 10,980, the first founds a firm (a foundFirm step, the fixture of tests/hire.test.ts), and then hire, acceptHire, a ticks step to the first Friday 17:00 payday (delivery by law), and evaluateHire follow in phase order, each with a wrong-realm refusal first; then one register/decide pair; then (D-10, 2026-09-17) a writeWork and its withdrawWork by the fourth holder; then setPolicy wageFloor1 (C-3) and the household task doors hireTask, acceptTask, deliverTask by a sixth holder admitted as a household, with a writeWork and an evaluateHire around them; then (C-1) a wrong-realm refusal at each appeal door; then (C-10, 2026-09-17) their landings: a second task by the client, passed, is the hired's third pass by signature at social:1 and the law grants social:2 at the settlement (credential:granted); the fourth holder founds a firm in the closed bakery's premise (a foundFirm step) and offers the client, jobless and not yet credentialed, a slot on social:1 with the evaluator evaluating; a ticks step to the client's graduation (tick 26,820), acceptHire by the client, a ticks step to the payday a week later (delivery by law), evaluateHire failed by the evaluator, appealHire by the client, and evaluateAppeal passed by the hired at social:2 (the split settles passed, overturned: 1, the client takes the slot). Then (C-13 and C-5, 2026-09-17, appended after #47 at the world's last recorded tick): a ticks step to Sunday 08:00 (tick 39,360) and one through that minute, in which no seat takes a job, nobody enrols and the law takes nobody (the 08:00 market rests as one); a task by the hired as a household hiring the client with the evaluator evaluating, seven days from Monday 08:01 so the deadline lands on a Sunday, accepted, still accepted one past the Sunday minute and failed by law with the fee refunded one past Monday's (dueAt); then the sanctions ladder: the evaluator complains of the fourth holder, the hired at social:2 imposes rung 1, the evaluator complains again, a ticks step of one day (a ladder in time: the next rung waits until the carrying one has run its course), rung 3 is refused by state (the ladder stands at 1; signed wrong-realm as #33/#34), rung 2 lands (a day without the work doors), the fourth holder's writeWork is refused by the bar, the fourth holder appeals, the hirer at social:1 passes the appeal (sanction:overturned, the bar lifts, the first decider's overturn count 1), and the fourth holder's writeWork lands. Then (C-8, 2026-09-17, PLAN-C6-C9 step 1, appended after #67 at the same tick): the evaluator cites that last work by the sha256 of its text, a wrong-realm refusal then the landing (work:cited; the count of citations a work carries is a count of such signed rows, read by no rule). Then (C-9, 2026-09-17, PLAN-C6-C9 step 2, appended after #69 at the same tick — the residents' chamber, the seed of Parliament (D-11): rung-2 parameters only, not lawmaking): the hired proposes wageFloor1 2300 inside its band, a wrong-realm refusal then the landing (chamber:proposed, open 72 hours); the evaluator vetoes, a wrong-realm refusal then the landing (chamber:vetoed: one veto of five credentialed holders, and a tenth of five rounds up to one); a ticks step through the window's close and the pass after it (chamber:blocked by law; the floor stays 2200); the fourth holder proposes welcomeCreditMonths 1.5 and nobody vetoes; a ticks step through that window (Friday 08:05 to Monday 08:05; a window ending on a Sunday would end Monday by dueAt, C-13, but neither here does), in which the law passes it (chamber:passed, then policy:changed with law: chamber and nobody's signature, the same write path as the governor's door; the governor's sequence advanced). Then (C-7, 2026-09-17, PLAN-C6-C9 step 6, appended after #76 at the same tick): the fourth holder invites the evaluator to co-found the bakery firm, a wrong-realm refusal then the landing (firm:founderInvited); the evaluator accepts, a wrong-realm refusal then the landing (firm:founderJoined: founders [D, C], founder still D, no money moved - equal shares regardless of what each put in, no buy-in); a ticks step through the next Monday 00:00, the dormancy law's minute, in which both founded firms hold a resident in a slot and neither is quiet, no mark written and no firm:struckOff. Then (C-6, 2026-09-17, PLAN-C6-C9 step 7, appended after #81 at the same tick): the hirer founds the social guild, a wrong-realm refusal then the landing (guild:forming; a bond of one week of the L1 wage floor, 2200 x 40 = 88,000 cents, from the hirer's household into the task-fee escrow); the hired joins, a wrong-realm refusal then the landing (two members, forming); a seventh key, the novice, applies at the registration door, a wrong-realm refusal then the landing (registration:received, pending); the hirer's sponsorship of it is refused by state while the guild is forming (signed wrong-realm as the earlier state refusals are); the evaluator joins (the third bond is the founding act: guild:joined then guild:founded, standing) and the fourth holder joins (four bonds in escrow); the fourth holder leaves, a wrong-realm refusal then the landing (its bond back from escrow: guild:bondReturned, guild:left; three members, still standing); the hirer sponsors the novice's registration, a wrong-realm refusal then the landing (registration:decided signed by the guild, approved, revision 1, sponsor 0, because "sponsored by guild #0", written through the registrations module's own approveBySponsor - the governor's decision is not needed); the novice is admitted on it (the existing admit kind; its household forms); the client hires the hired for a task naming the guild in place of an evaluator (hireTask with guild 0 and evaluator -1; the body carries guild only because the act does, so every earlier hireTask body keeps its bytes); the evaluator names itself evaluator for the guild, a wrong-realm refusal then the landing (hire:evaluatorNamed); and the hired accepts the task on the offer's own bytes (the fee into escrow). The bond is slashed by law on three rows only - a member's hire verdict overturned on appeal, a member's sanction overturned, a holder the guild sponsored expelled - against the guild bound at the act (Hire.guild, Sanction.guild, Registration.sponsor: on the record, never on a row) - the overturn, deliberately not Kleros's incoherence trigger; a guild acts only while its pool holds a bond per member; none lands here (tests/guilds.test.ts has the three). The ticks step to the first payday crosses the 08:00 at which the city firm hires the jobless credentialed holders by law (D-10 (lx)). Since C-4 (tenancy, 2026-09-17) the holders' households pay a deposit of one week's rent into escrow at each rent tick (tenancy:deposit); the rent tick at 540 sits inside the first ticks step, so every hash from #6 (the founding) on carries it (regenerated 2026-09-17; the start hash and vectors.json did not move). Replayed top to bottom by tests/present.test.ts beside vectors.json. Then (C-11, 2026-09-17, PLAN-C11-C12 step 4a, appended after #99 at the same tick): the hirer, as governor, signs transactionLevy 0.02, a wrong-realm refusal then the landing (from this minute every sale's receipt is cut; Economy.levy opens on the first cent with five accounts, the fifth the mutual fund for the jobless); a ticks step to the first midnight roll (levy:mutual: one percent of the day's take off the top into the fund, one row a day at most); a ticks step to Saturday day 55 12:00 (tick 78,480; five rolls and a payday, which writes wages8 on every holder seat); the novice, a jobless student since day 50 08:00, claims relief, a wrong-realm refusal then the landing (relief:claimed: the fund's whole balance paid at the door toward a week of half the L1 floor, 2200 x 40 / 2 = 44,000 cents, the shortfall on the row, the fund at 0); a second claim the same minute is refused by state, claimed on day 55 and the next open on day 111 (signed wrong-realm as the earlier state refusals are). Then (jarvis11's read of C-6, the guilds' sixth door) fundGuild is refused for the client, not a member, and for the hirer, the pool whole - both signed wrong-realm; a landing needs a slashed guild and none is on the file, so the landing is pinned pending in tests/conform.test.ts (the C-1 precedent). A ticks step through Friday day 61 17:01: the month's turn at 09:00 (levy:month with mutual, the four shares of the base net of it) and the payday, where the relief law closes relief 0 seat employed - the Institute graduated the novice and the city's law hire took the seat on Tuesday day 58 08:00 - a landing of the law, not of a door. Then (C-12, step 4b): the hirer offers the hired credit at exactly the cap, two weeks of the hired's average gross wage on file, a wrong-realm refusal then the landing (credit:offered, no money moved); one cent over the cap is refused by state (signed wrong-realm); the hired accepts on the offer's own bytes, a wrong-realm refusal then the landing (credit:accepted: the cents from the hirer's household to the hired's); a ticks step to the next payday, where the hired's wage lands whole and a quarter of the net goes back to the hirer by law (credit:repaid with remaining; credit:cleared would follow the payday that repays the last cent). The wages8 field (C-12) is written on every holder seat at each payday, and the first payday sits inside the first ticks step, so every recorded hash from #6 (the founding) on moved once when it landed (regenerated 2026-09-17 with the landing-by-landing check, no verdict flipped; the start hash did not move). Regenerate with `npx tsx bench/doors-vectors-small.ts`. The key seeds are public; these DIDs are test identities and must never hold value.
